'''Omwat''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was a world of grasslands and mountains and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the native [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]].

The planet's surface was covered with [[Honeycomb settlement|honeycomb-like cities]], of which were built by the Omwati and devoted to advancing the sciences, arts, and technologies of their [[Species/Legends|species]]. Despite the Omwati's growing technological sophistication, Omwat's natural resources were used sparingly, in order to avoid overwhelming them.<ref name="AAUAA">''[[Alien Anthology]]'' {{C|Under ''Omwati''}}; information repeated in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' {{C|Under ''Omwati''}}</ref>

==History==
Sometime in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], a group of indigenous Omwati established a small but successful colony on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Their homeworld of Omwat was long forgotten by [[The galaxy/Legends|the galactic]] community, until its rediscovery by [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space. Omwat was the site of a [[Battle of Omwat|battle]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. The planet was later subjugated by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] Wilhuff Tarkin. Tarkin abducted a number of Omwati children from the planet to be trained as [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] think-tank geniuses in an orbiting center.

At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Omwati achieved space travel via the creation of a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and contacted their Coruscant kin. Omwat eventually joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Under the New Republic's rule, the Omwati developed [[Omwati Force tradition|their own Force tradition]], which was taught on Omwat.<ref name="AAUAA" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Omwat in the [[Dolomar sector/Legends|Dolomar sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]].
